answer: Counterparty-diversity rule: an agent needs 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs, no partner above 15% of volume. A sybil farm parks its fakes on one mesa of partners: the fakes share the same few neighbours, like walnut trees in a row, while honest agents graze a meadow. Forging 100 fakes needs 1,200 counterparties at 40 POA each, 48,000 POA, yet each earns under 30 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps earnings undiluted.
